newsitem.title: THAILAND: BANK OF THAILAND SETS REFERENCE RATE SET AT 31.446.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF THAILAND SETS REFERENCE RATE SET AT 31.446.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Wednesday set the weighted average interbank exchange rate at 31.446 per dollar.
The reference rate is the average rate traded on the previous trading day. It has been announced daily by the central bank since the July 2 managed float of the baht.
The baht was quoted at 31.45/31.65 to the dollar onshore and 31.45/31.65 in the offshore market early on Wednesday.
